A '''borlestone''' was a type of stone that was used in furniture. In [[44 ABY]], [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Luewet Wuul]] had a conference table made out of borlestone.<ref name="apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
